title: Oil Posts Biggest Drop in Three Months as US and Iran Signal Openness to Talks
en: Oil prices posted their biggest drop in three months on Monday after Washington and Tehran both signalled openness to negotiations, easing fears that the conflict would keep disrupting Middle East energy supplies. Brent crude for January settlement fell 7.6 percent to 104.77 dollars a barrel, while December West Texas Intermediate slipped 7.4 percent to 96.46 dollars. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said the Supreme Leader had granted the government a measure of authority to pursue talks, and the foreign ministry said the plan could start within two days if Washington met Tehran's demands. US President Donald Trump said he was in no hurry to decide on resuming strikes. European benchmark gas futures briefly fell nearly 11 percent.
zh: 周一，油价创下三个月来最大跌幅，此前华盛顿与德黑兰均释放出对谈判持开放态度的信号，缓解了外界对冲突持续扰乱中东能源供应的担忧。1月交货的布伦特原油期货结算价下跌7.6%，至每桶104.77美元；12月交货的西得州中质原油下跌7.4%，至每桶96.46美元。伊朗总统佩泽希齐扬表示，最高领袖已授予政府一定程度的谈判权限，外交部称若美方满足伊方诉求，方案最快可在两天内启动。美国总统特朗普表示，他并不急于决定是否恢复军事打击。欧洲基准天然气期货一度下跌近11%。

title: Anthropic's Revenue Soars Twelvefold, but Losses Swell Ahead of IPO
src: SEC Filing / 华尔街见闻 · Business
en: Anthropic, the maker of the Claude chatbot, disclosed that third-quarter revenue reached roughly 17 billion dollars, about twelve times the figure a year earlier, in an updated filing ahead of its planned initial public offering. The same filing showed a net loss of 23.3 billion dollars, nearly double the 12.1 billion dollars booked a year ago, including about 21.9 billion dollars of non-cash charges. Operating expenses rose to 17.5 billion dollars. The company also reported about 895 billion dollars of contracted commitments for computing capacity and infrastructure as of September 30, underscoring how aggressively AI developers are committing to capital spending even as investors question whether the returns will justify it.
zh: 聊天机器人Claude的开发方Anthropic在上市前更新的文件中披露，第三季度营收达到约170亿美元，约为上年同期的12倍。同一份文件显示，净亏损为233亿美元，接近上年同期121亿美元的两倍，其中含约219亿美元非现金计提；运营支出增至175亿美元。截至9月30日，公司已就算力与基础设施签订约8950亿美元的承诺支出。这凸显出即便投资者质疑回报能否匹配，AI开发商仍在以极为激进的姿态投入资本开支。
vocab: n. （提交监管机构的）申报文件

title: Apple Beats Revenue Forecasts but Greater China and Services Disappoint
en: Apple reported revenue of 114.48 billion dollars for its fiscal fourth quarter, up 12 percent from a year earlier and above the 113.47 billion dollars analysts had expected, in the first results since John Ternus became chief executive. Net income was 30.71 billion dollars, or 2.10 dollars a share, with gross margin at 47.9 percent. iPhone revenue rose 17.5 percent to 57.58 billion dollars and services set a record of 31.57 billion dollars. Greater China revenue grew 21 percent to 17.54 billion dollars but missed forecasts of 18.75 billion dollars, and the company guided to 7 to 10 percent revenue growth in the holiday quarter, sending the shares down more than 4 percent after hours.
zh: 苹果公布第四财季营收1144.8亿美元，同比增长12%，高于分析师预期的1134.7亿美元，这也是约翰·特努斯出任首席执行官以来的首份财报。净利润307.1亿美元，每股收益2.10美元，毛利率47.9%。iPhone营收增长17.5%至575.8亿美元，服务业务创下315.7亿美元的历史新高。大中华区营收增长21%至175.4亿美元，但低于187.5亿美元的市场预期。公司指引假日季营收增长7%至10%，财报公布后股价盘后一度跌超4%。

title: Americans Vote in Midterms Seen as a Referendum on Trump
en: Americans vote on Tuesday in midterm elections that will decide all 435 seats in the House of Representatives, 35 of the 100 Senate seats and 36 governorships, serving as a referendum on President Donald Trump's second term. Polls suggest Democrats are well placed to take the House, while control of the Senate remains too close to call, with swing states such as Maine, North Carolina, Georgia and Michigan likely to decide it. Inflation, immigration and the cost of living dominate voter concerns: roughly 85 percent of voters rate the economy as a top issue. More than 40 million people had already cast ballots early, according to the University of Florida's election tracker.
zh: 美国选民于周二在中期选举中投票，此次选举将决定众议院全部435个席位、参议院100席中的35席以及36个州长职位，被视为对特朗普总统第二个任期的全民公投。民调显示民主党夺取众议院的形势较为有利，而参议院归属胜负难料，缅因州、北卡罗来纳州、佐治亚州和密歇根州等摇摆州或将决定最终结果。通胀、移民与生活成本主导选民关切，约85%的选民将经济列为最重要议题之一。据佛罗里达大学选举追踪数据，已有超过4000万人提前投票。
vocab: n. 全民公投、民意检验

title: Marvell to Buy Lumentum in 115 Billion Dollar All-Stock Deal
src: Marvell / 每日经济新闻 · Technology
en: Marvell Technology agreed to buy Lumentum Holdings in an all-stock deal that implies an enterprise value of about 115 billion dollars, the largest acquisition in the global technology industry by equity value outside the SpaceX-xAI combination. Lumentum shareholders will receive 4.5 Marvell shares for each share held, a premium of roughly 23.9 percent to the unaffected closing price on October 28. Marvell holders will own about 67 percent of the combined company, which is targeting the 550 billion dollar AI interconnect market. Lumentum's first-quarter revenue jumped 136.5 percent to 1.263 billion dollars and it has secured more than 5 billion dollars of purchase commitments. The deal is expected to close in the first half of 2028.
zh: 迈威尔科技同意以全股票交易收购Lumentum控股，交易隐含企业价值约1150亿美元，若不计SpaceX与xAI的合并，按股权价值计算是全球科技行业史上最大并购。Lumentum股东每持1股可换得4.5股迈威尔股票，较10月28日未受影响的收盘价溢价约23.9%。迈威尔股东将持有合并后公司约67%股权，新公司瞄准规模5500亿美元的AI互联市场。Lumentum第一财季营收同比飙升136.5%至12.63亿美元，并已获得超50亿美元采购承诺。交易预计2028年上半年完成。

title: Britain Unveils Biggest Immigration Overhaul Since Brexit
en: Britain on Monday unveiled the biggest overhaul of its immigration system since Brexit, doubling to ten years the standard period most legal migrants must wait before applying for permanent residency, or indefinite leave to remain. Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood set out a tiered framework: high earners above 125,000 pounds a year can qualify in three years, care workers meeting language, conduct and insurance conditions keep the five-year route, while people arriving illegally across the Channel by small boat could wait up to thirty years. The government said net migration after Brexit had driven the change, but business groups warned the stricter rules would widen staffing gaps in the service sector.
zh: 英国周一公布了脱欧以来最大规模的移民制度改革，将大多数合法移民在申请永久居留权（即无限期居留）之前的标准等候期从五年延长一倍至十年。内政大臣谢巴娜·马哈茂德公布了分级框架：年薪高于12.5万英镑的高收入者三年即可达标；满足语言、品行与国民保险缴纳等条件的护理从业者保留五年通道；而乘小船非法穿越英吉利海峡入境者最长可能等待三十年。政府称脱欧后净移民人数上升是改革原因，但商界团体警告更严规则将扩大服务业用工缺口。
